signature: SUBROUTINE ZGBTRS( TRANS, N, KL, KU, NRHS, AB, LDAB, IPIV, B, LDB,

params.name: trans
params.reference:
Specifies the form of the system of equations.

-   `= 'N'`: $A \, X = B$     (No transpose)
-   `= 'T'`: $A^T \, X = B$  (Transpose)
-   `= 'C'`: $A^H \, X = B$  (Conjugate transpose)

params.name: N
params.reference: The order of the matrix A. $N \ge 0$.

params.name: kl
params.reference: The number of subdiagonals within the band of A. $\mathrm{KL} \ge 0$.

params.name: ku
params.reference: The number of superdiagonals within the band of A. $\mathrm{KU} \ge 0$.

params.name: nrhs
params.reference: The number of right hand sides, i.e., the number of columns of the matrix B. $\mathrm{NRHS} \ge 0$.

params.name: AB
params.reference: Details of the LU factorization of the band matrix A, as computed by ZGBTRF. U is stored as an upper triangular band matrix with `KL`+`KU` superdiagonals in rows 1 to `KL`+`KU`+1, and the multipliers used during the factorization are stored in rows `KL`+`KU`+2 to $2 \, \mathrm{KL}+\mathrm{KU}+1$.

params.name: ldab
params.reference: The leading dimension of the array `AB`. $\mathrm{LDAB} \ge 2 \, \mathrm{KL}+\mathrm{KU}+1$.

params.name: IPIV
params.reference: The pivot indices; for $1 \le i \le N$, row i of the matrix was interchanged with row `IPIV(i)`.

params.name: B
params.reference: On entry, the right hand side matrix B. On exit, the solution matrix X.

params.name: ldb
params.reference: The leading dimension of the array B. $\mathrm{LDB} \ge \max (1,N)$.

params.name: info
params.reference:
-   `= 0`: successful exit
-   `< 0`: if `INFO = -i`, the i-th argument had an illegal value
